analyst_view.overall: CSKA Sofia (28th, 1 pt) host Trabzonspor (12th, 6 pts) at their renovated stadium; both need points, Trabzonspor after a home defeat to Freiburg on matchday 3. CSKA drew 3-3 at Botev Plovdiv at the weekend, and Markus Gisdol called Trabzonspor a very strong side; Cotter and Leo Pereira are not available to them. Trabzonspor's Dju (their top European scorer), Folcarelli and Batagov trained with the team on Tuesday after injuries, but Turkish reports still list them short of fitness, and the expected XI has Onuachu up front with Muci, Salah and Saviolo behind; Simsir and Yokuslu are out (counted) and Malinovskyi, Umut Nayir and Habesoglu are not on the UEFA list. Coach Thomas Reis is not expected to rotate, and Cabral is available again. French referee Jeremie Pignard is named, and the numbers already add about 12% to cards for his record.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals, 1.6 of them Trabzonspor's, and they only take off Simsir and Yokuslu. Dju, Folcarelli and Batagov were back in training on Tuesday but are reported short of fitness and not in the expected XI, so Trabzonspor likely lack their top European scorer from the start, which the numbers can't see. Their return to training is why I trim the size from -4% to -3%, about 2.6 goals.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners, split evenly. CSKA must attack at home and Trabzonspor push their full-backs, but the numbers already add a little for both sides' recent corner counts and the absences don't change how either side plays wide, so I stay at about 9.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.8 cards, well above a usual game, because they add 12% for referee Pignard's record on top of both sides' recent bookings. A home game in a loud, newly reopened stadium can get heated, but that figure is already high and nothing else specific points further, so I stay at about 5.8.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.5 shots, already lifted 12% for CSKA's recent volume. CSKA chasing their first league-phase win should keep the game open, while a Trabzonspor side without Dju may shoot a little less; those roughly cancel, so I stay at about 29.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.2 shots on target, already raised for CSKA's recent accuracy. Without Dju and Folcarelli in the starting side, Trabzonspor lose some of their finishing and chance creation, which the numbers don't know, but both are close to returning, so I lean only slightly lower: -2% gives about 10.0.
